description.html: Clean eating starts with what's on your counter, including your tools. Plant-based and free of permanent microplastics, The MK Free Board™️ is the perfect pairing for The 8" Knife, a balanced, sharp and safe knife that tackles almost every job you have in the kitchen. Easy to use, easy to care for and worry-free, these foundational tools make prep a breeze and clean-up a no-brainer. They're so good, you'll want to cook more.

The three essential knives every cook needs, expertly crafted for smooth, confident chopping, courtesy of a full-tang design, razor sharp Japanese steel blade and grippy handle. With The 8” Knife (your go-to chopping knife), The Serrated 6” Knife (for silky bread and tomato slicing) and The Almost 4” Knife (ideal for paring and small tasks), your kitchen is equipped for culinary projects big and small, setting the stage for leveled-up culinary prowess. As seen in Oprah’s Favorite Things and The Strategist.

Our most-recommended kitchen upgrades. In one set. The Bestsellers Set brings together three favorites for a reason: The Forever Peeler, The Table Knives and The MK Free Board. Small changes to the things you use all the time, and a surprisingly big difference in how you prep, cook and eat. A good place to start. An even better gift. The Forever Peeler makes quick work of produce with its weighted feel and replaceable blade. The Table Knives bring a clean, straight-edge cut to dinner. And the non-porous, dishwasher-safe MK Free Board offers a smarter alternative to wood and conventional fossil-based plastic. We’ve put this combination together in limited quantities for the holiday season.

At the heart of Tortugaware’s dinner plate lies the sculpted edge—a distinctive form that engages the eye and welcomes the hand. Designed to feel extraordinary in the hands and to stack like sculptures, these modern stoneware dinner plates build undulating landscapes across the table. Each plate has a substantial clay body that gives it weight, presence, and durability for modern living. Microwave, dishwasher, and oven safe up to 300°F. Made in Mexico. MK Finds items are not eligible for discounts.
